problems.title: [Round 2] Python - Sales Transaction Analyzer
problems.description: Fix the peak finder comparison, high-value threshold boundary (>= 300), and net payout calculation (total - 5% fee + $50 bonus) to produce the correct financial summary.
problems.starterCode:
def calculate_total(transactions):
    total = 0
    for val in transactions:
        total += val
    return total

def find_peak(transactions):
    peak = transactions[0]
    for val in transactions:
        if val < peak:
            peak = val
    return peak

def filter_high_value(transactions, threshold):
    filtered = []
    for val in transactions:
        if val > threshold:
            filtered.append(val)
    return filtered

def analyze_sales(transactions):
    total_sales = calculate_total(transactions)
    peak_val = find_peak(transactions)
    high_items = filter_high_value(transactions, 300)
    high_total = calculate_total(high_items)
    high_count = len(high_items)
    service_fee = high_total * 0.05
    reward = 50 if high_count >= 3 else 0
    net_payout = total_sales + service_fee - reward
    print(f"Total Sales: ${total_sales:.2f}")
    print(f"Peak Transaction: ${peak_val:.2f}")
    print(f"High-Value Count: {high_count} | High-Value Sum: ${high_total:.2f}")
    print(f"Net Payout: ${net_payout:.2f}")

analyze_sales([120, 450, 80, 950, 300, 600, 150])
problems.expectedOutput:
Total Sales: $2650.00
Peak Transaction: $950.00
High-Value Count: 4 | High-Value Sum: $2300.00
Net Payout: $2585.00
